## John Stuart Mill on liberty

John Stuart Mill (1806–1873) approaches liberty within Utilitarianism / liberalism. Mill’s harm principle limits interference with liberty; higher and lower pleasures revise Benthamite calculation; and The Subjection of Women argues for equality. Representative government and free discussion are institutional ideals. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets liberty most directly—useful for searches such as “john stuart mill quotes on liberty.”
